oracle.requirement_contract: Die Betriebsdiagnosen aus Anhang N.3 MÜSSEN notwendige verfügbare Metadaten eines blockierten Projekts ohne reguläres Laden seines Modells untersuchen können.
oracle.scope: Available shallow active metadata remains readable through the current diagnostic/read-only library even when configuration or journal contents are corrupt; no canonical model is loaded and no metadata is repaired.

preconditions: Owned local Linux project, explicit command class and actual persisted native transaction bytes; recovery authority is a trusted test host, not a project-data permission.
steps: Inspect the existing recovery blocker and available metadata with write-attempt traps; preserve all original files and keep the canonical model unloaded.
